alt: Pink and orange sunset over open green pastures, with the paved ranch drive running between fenced fields
Two horses, one white and one buckskin, standing at a wire fence in a sunny pasture
Inside the barn: a row of new pine horse stalls with black steel grille fronts and ceiling fans
Stall row with tall pine walls, black steel bars and a fan mounted over each stall
An open stall door showing a clean, roomy pine-lined stall, with a muck fork and trash can nearby
Wide concrete barn aisle seen from the roll-up door, with steel walls and a stall on the right
Barn tack room wall finished in stained wood planks, with a white door and the roll-up door open to the lot
Large gravel lot for trucks, horse trailers and RVs under a clear blue sky, trees along the edge
Front of the single-level ranch house with white siding and front steps, set back from a gravel drive
Bright kitchen with white cabinets, marble-look island, three bar stools and stainless range
Kitchen and entry hallway with a stainless refrigerator, tall pantry cabinets and wood-look floors
Coffee bar with floating shelves and a coffee maker beside the washer
Primary bedroom with a queen bed in green bedding, a wooden dresser and a wall-mounted TV
Second bedroom with a blue plaid quilt, rustic nightstand and table lamp
Third bedroom with a patterned grey and white comforter and a bedside lamp
Primary bathroom with a double-sink vanity, tiled wall and fresh flowers
Second bathroom with a red striped shower curtain, toilet and single-sink vanity
Laundry nook with a front-loading washer, white cabinets and open shelves
